branding.title: Cursor Community Welcome
branding.subtitle: Configurable animated welcome screens for workshops and events

sections.text: Welcome to the Cursor Community welcome screen — a configurable animated display for workshops and events.
The home stage opens with the Cursor logo, your community brand, a word-by-word headline, today’s date, and a floating particle backdrop.
The brand name is the hero signal — swap it for your chapter or community without touching code.
The headline welcomes attendees and animates word by word, with the last few words highlighted for stage presence.
The date can follow today automatically, or you can lock a fixed event day from the editor.
Top-right controls open the editor, enter presentation preview, or copy a shareable configuration link.
Keyboard shortcuts keep the stage smooth — press E to open the editor, F or P for fullscreen preview, and Escape to close.
Click Edit to open the sidebar. Customize brand, title, date, auto-replay interval, and sponsors. Changes persist in local storage.
Tune Use today or a fixed date, set animation replay from five to sixty seconds or turn auto replay off, add up to five sponsor titles and names, and reset to defaults when you need a clean slate.
Shareable links encode the full configuration — custom brand, meetup headline, a locked event date, replay interval, and sponsor chips — so teammates open the same welcome screen instantly.
Sponsors appear beneath the date with a title and name for each partner, up to five entries on the welcome loop.
Re-open the editor anytime to add or remove sponsors, adjust the replay interval, or refine the welcome copy before doors open.
Share copies a URL with your configuration in the query string so anyone can restore the same brand, date, interval, and sponsors.
Preview — or press F or P — enters fullscreen presentation mode and hides chrome so the welcome animation fills the stage.
The footer credits the maker, India, and Cursor. That covers the full welcome experience — motion, editing, persistence, sponsors, sharing, and presentation mode.
